changes: Resource usage is collapsed by default in agent cards and workspace headers.
A fixed-size chart button opens CPU, memory, and disk usage in a native popover.
Metrics fetches and the 30-second refresh loop run only while the popover is visible.
Tool shortcut positions no longer depend on metric availability or the width of loaded values.

uiAssertions: No metrics request before the user opens details
Loaded CPU, memory, and storage values are accessible
Terminal and Desktop retain their original frames after details close
Terminal remains tappable and opens normally

distributionNotes: Published to the existing internal group only; no external beta review or App Store version/review submission is created.
Native macOS receives the 1.2 maintenance version; the resource control change applies to the shared iOS, iPadOS and visionOS UI.
